title: Payment result reshaped while checkout grows a failure branch

agents.task: In src/lib/payments.ts, simplify the PaymentResult contract: rename the `status` property to `state` (same union type 'created' | 'failed') and remove the `redirectUrl` property entirely, since redirects are now handled by the gateway. Update createPayment accordingly so the module type-checks on its own. Do not touch other files.

In src/app/checkout/page.tsx, improve CheckoutPage: when the payment failed, return the string `Payment failed (<payment id>)` using the payment's `id`; when the payment was created, keep returning the redirect URL if present and 'Payment created' otherwise. Add a second test in src/tests/checkout.test.ts covering the failed branch (createPayment fails when amountCents is 0, so you may need to make CheckoutPage accept an optional amountCents parameter defaulting to 1299). Do not touch src/lib/payments.ts.
